g.aria-label: Why Width-4 Short Causal Convolution Is Essential for Matrix States
In stream [k_1, v_1, k_2, v_2, ..., q], key k_i arrives at t−1 and value v_i at t
To store (k_i, v_i), outer product v_t k_tᵀ at step t must see BOTH x_{t-1} = k_i and x_t = v_i!
k_t = W_k x_t, v_t = W_v x_t
• k_t depends ONLY on value token v_i!
• Never binds v_i to preceding key k_i
• Step t writes v_i k_iᵀ into S_t!
• Acts as an implicit induction head
